name: Journal
for: a long-form essay, magazine feature, newsletter issue, research write-up or personal blog post
description: Made for reading for twenty minutes: a measure of about 66 characters, a serif with real italics, a drop cap, a wide figure with its caption, a pull quote, a section break, footnotes that link both ways, and the author's note at the end. Dark mode is sepia ink on a night page.

images.prompt: A wide photograph of a grey northern sea at low tide under a pale moon, mudflats and channels, soft overcast light, quiet, no people

type.display: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif
type.text: Charter, "Bitstream Charter", "Sitka Text", Cambria, Georgia, serif
